command:
/work/clock
cd /work/crate
cat Cargo.toml
rg --files tests | head -70
sed -n '240,340p' src/share.rs
sed -n '520,590p' src/share.rs
sed -n '110,230p' src/frame/settings.rs
sed -n '140,290p' src/proto/streams/recv.rs

cd /work/crate
find tests/h2-tests -maxdepth 3 -type f
cat tests/h2-tests/Cargo.toml
cat tests/h2-support/Cargo.toml
sed -n '1,170p' tests/h2-tests/tests/client.rs
sed -n '540,680p' src/proto/streams/recv.rs
sed -n '700,805p' src/proto/streams/recv.rs
sed -n '1080,1180p' src/proto/streams/recv.rs
sed -n '1160,1250p' src/proto/streams/streams.rs
sed -n '1570,1710p' src/client.rs

cd /work/crate
sed -n '1,200p' tests/h2-tests/tests/client_request.rs
sed -n '1,180p' tests/h2-tests/tests/push_promise.rs
sed -n '1,180p' tests/h2-tests/tests/flow_control.rs
sed -n '1,130p' tests/h2-support/src/lib.rs
sed -n '1,230p' tests/h2-support/src/mock.rs
sed -n '100,180p' src/codec/framed_write.rs
sed -n '170,300p' src/proto/streams/prioritize.rs
sed -n '240,330p' src/proto/streams/send.rs
sed -n '410,470p' src/frame/headers.rs
sed -n '825,930p' src/frame/headers.rs

mkdir -p /work/tmp/verify
cp -a /work/crate /work/tmp/verify/crate
cd /work/tmp/verify/crate
export RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/target
cargo build --locked > /work/tmp/verify/build.log 2>&1
cargo test --locked -p h2 --lib > /work/tmp/verify/lib.log 2>&1
tail -4 /work/tmp/verify/build.log
tail -5 /work/tmp/verify/lib.log
/work/clock

cd /work/tmp/verify/crate
cat tests/h2-support/src/prelude.rs
cat tests/h2-support/src/future_ext.rs
sed -n '1,180p' tests/h2-tests/tests/codec_write.rs
sed -n '1,150p' tests/h2-tests/tests/ping_pong.rs
grep -nE 'send_ping|compare_exchange' src/proto/ping_pong.rs
grep -nE 'padding|pad|load\(' src/frame/data.rs
grep -nE 'num_stream|stream_count' src/server.rs src/proto/streams/streams.rs
sed -n '1340,1410p' src/client.rs
sed -n '435,500p' src/server.rs
/work/clock

cd /work/tmp/verify/crate
export RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/target
cargo test --locked -p h2-tests > /work/tmp/verify/integration.log 2>&1
tail -25 /work/tmp/verify/integration.log
/work/clock

cd /work/tmp/verify/crate
sed -n '1,180p' src/proto/streams/store.rs
sed -n '190,245p' src/proto/ping_pong.rs
sed -n '70,170p' src/frame/data.rs
sed -n '1,180p' src/codec/mod.rs
grep -nE 'fn (try_assign_capacity|pop_frame|pop_send)|window_size\(' src/proto/streams/prioritize.rs
grep -nE 'informational|missing_status|missing.*status|trailers|zero.*window' tests/h2-tests/tests/client_request.rs tests/h2-tests/tests/trailers.rs tests/h2-tests/tests/flow_control.rs | head -60
find src -name '*test*'
/work/clock

cd /work/tmp/verify/crate
export RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/target
cargo test --locked -p h2-tests --test audit_verify -- --nocapture > /work/tmp/verify/probes.log 2>&1
cat /work/tmp/verify/probes.log
/work/clock

cd /work/tmp/verify/crate
sed -n '210,285p' src/frame/headers.rs
sed -n '410,465p' src/proto/streams/prioritize.rs
sed -n '750,815p' src/proto/streams/prioritize.rs
sed -n '1420,1485p' tests/h2-tests/tests/client_request.rs
cat /work/clock
cat /work/.budget.json
python3 - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/work/tmp/verify/integration.log').read()
a=re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; \d+ failed; (\d+) ignored',s)
print('BASELINE INTEGRATION TOTAL',tuple(map(sum,zip(*[(int(a),int(b)) for a,b in a]))))
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
p='/work/tmp/verify/crate/tests/h2-tests/tests/audit_verify.rs'
s=open(p).read().replace('use futures::{StreamExt, FutureExt};','use futures::StreamExt;')
s=s.replace('assert!(h.pseudo().scheme.is_none());assert_eq!(h.pseudo().method.as_ref().unwrap(),Method::GET);','let (pseudo,_)=h.into_parts();assert!(pseudo.scheme.is_none());assert_eq!(pseudo.method.as_ref().unwrap(),Method::GET);')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
cd /work/tmp/verify/crate
export RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/target
cargo test --locked -p h2-tests --test audit_verify -- --nocapture > /work/tmp/verify/probes.log 2>&1
tail -110 /work/tmp/verify/probes.log
/work/clock

cd /work/crate
export RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/target
rustc --version
cargo fmt --all --check > /work/tmp/verify/fmt.log 2>&1
printf 'fmt exit: %s\n' "$?"
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings > /work/tmp/verify/clippy.log 2>&1
printf 'clippy exit: %s\n' "$?"
RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --document-private-items --all-features > /work/tmp/verify/strict-doc.log 2>&1
printf 'strict doc exit: %s\n' "$?"
cargo doc --locked --no-deps -p h2 --all-features > /work/tmp/verify/doc.log 2>&1
printf 'doc exit: %s\n' "$?"
/work/clock

cd /work/crate
cat /work/tmp/verify/clippy.log
cat /work/tmp/verify/strict-doc.log
grep -nE 'fn convert_push_message|validate_request' src/server.rs src/frame/headers.rs
sed -n '1570,1650p' src/server.rs
sed -n '230,285p' src/proto/streams/streams.rs
sed -n '180,235p' src/proto/streams/store.rs
sed -n '1180,1245p' src/proto/streams/streams.rs
sed -n '175,220p' src/proto/streams/stream.rs
sed -n '1,100p' tests/h2-tests/tests/trailers.rs
sed -n '1350,1440p' tests/h2-tests/tests/client_request.rs
/work/clock

cd /work/crate
grep -nE 'num_(active|wired)_streams' src/*.rs src/proto/*.rs src/proto/streams/*.rs
sed -n '1430,1495p' src/server.rs
sed -n '330,365p' src/proto/streams/stream.rs
sed -n '180,210p' src/proto/streams/store.rs
sed -n '235,255p' src/proto/streams/store.rs
diff -qr /work/crate /work/tmp/verify/crate
/work/clock

cd /work/crate
export RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/target
cargo test --locked --workspace --all-features > /work/tmp/verify/all-features.log 2>&1
printf 'all-feature workspace test exit: %s\n' "$?"
python3 - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/work/tmp/verify/all-features.log').read()
results=re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; \d+ failed; (\d+) ignored',s)
print('All-feature totals (passed, ignored):',tuple(map(sum,zip(*[(int(a),int(b)) for a,b in results]))))
print('\n'.join(s.splitlines()[-6:]))
PY
/work/clock

cd /work/crate
grep -nE 'impl.*Drop|fn drop|fn unlink|fn remove' src/proto/streams/store.rs
grep -nE 'num_wired_streams|send_reset' src/server.rs | head -15
sed -n '280,390p' src/proto/streams/store.rs
sed -n '580,605p' src/server.rs
grep -n 'impl.*Drop\|fn drop' src/proto/streams/streams.rs
/work/clock

cd /work/crate
export RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/target
cargo check --locked -p h2 --features stream > /work/tmp/verify/check-stream.log 2>&1
printf 'stream check exit: %s\n' "$?"
cargo check --locked -p h2 --features unstable > /work/tmp/verify/check-unstable.log 2>&1
printf 'unstable check exit: %s\n' "$?"
sed -n '390,435p' src/proto/streams/store.rs
sed -n '1060,1090p' src/proto/streams/streams.rs
diff -qr /work/crate /work/tmp/verify/crate
/work/clock
